entities.summary: Antero Jorma Laukkanen was a Finnish pastor and politician who represented the Christian Democrats in the City Council of Espoo from 2001 until 2023 and in the Parliament of Finland from 2015 until 2023. He was elected to the Parliament from the Uusimaa constituency in the 2015 elections with 2,520 votes.
